scripts.build: pnpm --filter @staybridge/user run build && pnpm --filter @staybridge/municipality run build
scripts.test: pnpm run test:workflow && pnpm run test:workflows && pnpm run test:contrast && pnpm --filter @staybridge/domain --filter @staybridge/data --filter @staybridge/i18n --filter @staybridge/worker-runtime --filter @staybridge/user --filter @staybridge/municipality -r run test && pnpm run test:cd && pnpm run test:d1
scripts.db:local:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply STAYBRIDGE_DB --local --config apps/user/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:local:seed: wrangler d1 execute STAYBRIDGE_DB --local --config apps/user/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --file database/seed.sql --yes
scripts.db:local:init: pnpm run db:local:migrate && pnpm run db:local:seed
scripts.db:local:status: wrangler d1 migrations list STAYBRIDGE_DB --local --config apps/user/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:local:verify: wrangler d1 execute STAYBRIDGE_DB --local --config apps/user/wrangler.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state --command "SELECT value FROM backend_metadata WHERE key = 'seed_version'" --json
scripts.test:rendered: pnpm --filter @staybridge/user run test:rendered && pnpm --filter @staybridge/municipality run test:rendered
